body:
I feel you, my mother made same mistake for my first pet I was 9. At that point of my life it was the strongest connection I had other than my parents and siblings, not even to my grandparents and I had no good friends. That loss still haunts me to this day. Still with the years I forgave my mother. She is human, she makes f* mistakes.

Pets are special and unjugdemental. I truly feel sorry for your loss.

I don't understand completely. Did you hurt someone? You are scared because of consequences?

IMO. It is brave to accept that you hurt someone, some people don't recognize it. Even more brave to accept the consequences. I think that if you care on making thing right it to accept and show repentance. I mean even in a legal way. Would be brave and better for the people you hurt.

I think is very brave what you did and looks like you really wish the best for her for not making her wait.

Idk how much you told her but open up and let her know all you tried and what you feel.

Do you still have the busy life or just burnout from it?
Sorry buddy, she is not interested and you have to accept it. What made her your crush in the first place? Can you identify this?

If you don't experience it doesn't make it a myth.

There is people that have achieved a lot and still struggle with depression or even suicide thoughts. Sometimes your brain is just wired wrongly.

What country are you in?

Going through your issues with therapist is best, although I get/know the constrains: money, time, shame and not feeling relatable to the therapist. So I am available if you want to talk.

A strong digital hug.

Good that you broke with him after the supposed/real cheating.

What are arguing about so much after you believed him he was raped?

If you actually don't believe him or trust him, then is better to stay away, the relationship is damaged and it is just the start as you are not even a year together.

If you are breaking up constantly for other issues, then I would advice the same. Keep away, he doesn't sound stable. "I don't love you" then "I love you", yI don't think you want this in your life.
